source: Each plugin has a {0}. Names are unique, and the built-in plugins use the {1} prefix. Each capability has an {2}, unique within its kind. Two capabilities with the same id stop the load with {3}X18N1002{/3}, unless the later one sets {4}.
text: 每个插件都有一个 {0}。名称是唯一的，内置插件使用 {1} 前缀。每个能力都有一个 {2}，在同一类型内唯一。两个能力使用相同的 id 时，加载会以 {3}X18N1002{/3} 终止，除非后一个能力设置了 {4}。
